content.short: Multis is a multisig cryptocurrency wallet that requires two or more private keys to sign transactions.
content.description: Multis is an all-in-one web3 application that helps organizations manage their crypto-finances. It provides key tools for treasury operations, including high-interest savings accounts, automated trading, token swaps, and invoicing, and it includes a crypto wallet for businesses to access DeFi services. With Multis, teams can consolidate custody, increase efficiency, and streamline treasury workflows from a single platform, designed for organizations of varying sizes to manage assets and DeFi access.
content.meta: Multis offers a multisig wallet that requires two or more private keys to sign transactions. Discover Multis and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
